name: Noland-Haukenberry House
address: 216 North Delaware Street, Independence, Jackson County, MO

location.how: centre of the building's outline clicked by hand on the public ortho mo-2008 (2008, 0.152 m/px), pixel (620, 512); 1.6 m from the Google search's pin for the address

standing.note: The two-gabled house on the west side of Delaware Street, 130 x 65 px (19.8 x 9.9 m) on the 2008 ortho against the printed roof plan's 66 ft 8 in overall length. Placed on the 2008 ortho because the 2024 one is winter low-sun with the house in the shadow of the building south of it; the house is on every view 2008 to 2024 at the same place and no addition is seen at this resolution. NPS-owned (Harry S Truman NHS). A first placement on the 2024 ortho had picked the wrong roof and was corrected.

plan.note: Outside face of the first-floor walls. Start at the kitchen wing's NW corner, walk clockwise. Parts: two-story main block (living room, parlor) on the east; one-story kitchen and dining wing on the west; the enclosed south-facing porch (walled and glazed; the title sheet calls it an enclosed south-facing porch) south of the kitchen, in the outline; the foyer and stair, and the one-story bedroom, south of the main block. The drawn walls are slightly out of square (the porch's west and south walls are visibly skewed); the chain is rectilinear on the printed values. North-south extent 28'-2 1/4" = the printed overall of both the west and east strings. East-west the strings print 64'-9 1/2" (top) and 65'-0" (bottom) to the front porch's edge; less the porch (5'-9 3/4" and 5'-10 1/2") they give 58'-11 3/4" and 59'-1 1/2" for the walls; the chain's extent is 59'-1 1/4".

The kitchen wing's roof (west string 8'-1 3/4" + 5'-10 1/2" + 8'-6 1/2" = 22'-6 3/4" against its walls 20'-10 1/4") gives 0.85 ft; the main block's gable rakes (30'-1 1/2" roof against 28'-5 3/4" walls) 0.82 ft

roof.note: Main block: gable roof, ridge east-west, gable ends east (front, with ornamental gable) and west; a hipped roof over the two-story rear part south of it. Kitchen wing: gable roof, ridge east-west, carried down over the enclosed porch on the south. Front porch: its own low roof. Roof plan top string 30'-7" + 30'-1 1/2" + 5'-8" = 66'-4 1/2"; bottom 27'-0" + 9'-5 1/4" + 2'-8 1/4" + 6'-8" + 9'-4 1/2" + 11'-5 3/4" (read from a 1/4-scale crop, not checked digit by digit) adds to 66'-7 3/4" against the printed overall 66'-8"; west 28'-2 1/4" overall (segments add to 28'-2 1/2"); east 26'-6 3/4".
roof.derive_note: two-storey cross-gable block, hipped two-storey rear part and a one-storey kitchen wing: mixed eaves and pitches

Top string sheet 3: the main block's overall 28'-4 1/4" disagrees with its own segments (28'-5 3/4"); the segments are used (they close the chain against the bottom string's 59'-1 1/2" within 1/4"). Scaled between the two ticks 2835 px (28.35 ft); between the drawn wall faces about 2867 px (28.67 ft).
East string sheet 3 prints "10'-4"" for the main block's east wall; its own segments and the overall give 16'-4"; 16'-4" is used.

Second floor west string (sheet 4) prints 15'-4 1/2" and overall 27'-10" where its segments give 15'-6 1/2" and 27'-11" (= the east string's 27'-11"); the segments are used. Its bottom string's middle segments add to 15'-8 1/4" against the printed 15'-7 1/4" (used).
Grade levels are printed without a minus sign below FIRST FLOOR 0'-0": 2'-5 1/2" (east), 2'-5 1/4" (south), 2'-6 3/4" (west), 2'-2 1/2" (north). The east (front) elevation's is used.
